data.name: Jahsh
data.gender_notes: Jahsh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root j-h-sh, meaning 'to forget'. In Islamic history, Jahsh was a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who forgot a verse of the Quran and was reminded by the Prophet. This name is a reminder to always strive for knowledge and to not forget Allah's teachings. The name Jahsh carries the meaning “Forgetful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jahsh usually hope their child will grow to embody forgetful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Reminder to always seek knowledge and not forget Allah's teachings.
data.etymology: Jahsh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Forgetful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jahsh total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: جَحْش
in_arabic.meaning: المسمى بالجَحْشُ، وهو اسم علم من أسماء الرجال
in_arabic.long_meaning: الجَحْش: هو اسم علم عربي، يعود تاريخه إلى الجاهلية، وهو اسم من أسماء الرجال التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، ويُستخدم كاسم لابن آدم، ويعني الجَحْش: النشاز، أو الجَشم، وهو اسم لصاحب الجَشم، وهو أحد الأسماء التي ترد في سورة الفرقان، والمعروفة بترجمة سيدنا يوسف عليه السلام، ويُعتبر الجَحْش من الأسماء التي لها علاقة بالروحانية والدين

in_urdu.name: جَحْش
in_urdu.meaning: جنوبی ایشیائی مسلموں کا ایک نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: جَحْش: ایک عرب نام ہے جو اپنی جڑوں کو لیتا ہے، اس کے معنی ہیں نشاز اور جشم، جو ایک شخص کے لیے مخصوص نام ہے، اس نام کا تعلق قرآن کے سورہ فرقان سے ہے، جو کہ ایک اہم نام ہے جو جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں عام ہے، اس نام کی اہمیت اس کی روحانی اور مذہبی اہمیت ہے

in_hindi.name: जَح़श
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू मुस्लिम समुदाय का एक प्रसिद्ध नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: जَح़श: एक अरब नाम है जो अपने अर्थ के लिए जाना जाता है, इसका अर्थ है: नशाज़ या जश्म, जो एक व्यक्ति के लिए एक विशिष्ट नाम है, इसका संबंध कुरआन के सूरह फ़रकान से है, जो एक महत्वपूर्ण नाम है जो हिन्दू मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रसिद्ध है, इस नाम की महत्वपूर्णता इसके आध्यात्मिक और धार्मिक महत्व से है

in_pashto.name: جَحْش
in_pashto.long_meaning: جَحْش: دا په عربي نوم دی، چې د جاهليت په وخت کې رامنځته شو، دا په قرآن کې راغلي نوم دی، چې د يوسف عليه السلام د ترجماني په اړه ده، دا په افغانستان او پښتونو کې پښتونو کې عام نوم دی، دا په روحاني او ديني اړخ کې پښتونو کې مهم نوم دی

data.cultural_impact: The name Jahsh is not as commonly used as other Islamic names in the Muslim world. However, it holds an important place in Islamic history, specifically in the early community of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). Jahsh was one of the early companions of the Prophet, and his story teaches an important lesson about the value of knowledge and memory in the context of Islam.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jahsh carries a deep spiritual significance for Muslims. It reminds us of the importance of learning and remembering the teachings of Allah (swt) as revealed in the Quran. By forgetting a verse of the Quran, Jahsh demonstrated the potential danger of neglecting knowledge and the importance of diligent study. This story also highlights the companions' dedication to learning the Quran and their respect for the Prophet's guidance. Ultimately, Jahsh's story teaches us the importance of striving for knowledge and constantly reminding ourselves of Allah's word.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah, Volume 7, Page 321 The name Jahsh carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.time_period: During the Caliphate of Umar ibn Al-Khattab (634-644 AD)
historical_references.context: Jahsh bin Sabrah Al-Ansari, a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), was a leader of the Ansar (helpers) of Medina. He participated in various battles and was known for his bravery and generosity. Umar ibn Al-Khattab appointed him as a governor of Kufa and its surroundings.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Hajar Al-Asqalani's Al-Isabah fi Tamyiz Al-Sahabah, Volume 3, Page 592 The name Jahsh carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.time_period: After the death of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) (632 AD)
historical_references.context: Jahsh bin Sabrah Al-Ansari was a close companion of the Prophet and took part in numerous battles. After the Prophet's passing, he migrated to Syria and lived there until his death. He was known for his asceticism, piety, and generosity.
